newsitem.title: USA: Florida Power coal unit resumes full power.
newsitem.headline: Florida Power coal unit resumes full power.

text.p: Florida Power Corp's 750 megawatt (MW) Crystal River 4 coal-fired unit returned to service ahead of schedule last Friday, the company said Tuesday.
The unit was shut January 30 after a transformer fire.
The company had originally expected to restart the unit in the first or second week of March.
The company's adjacent Crystal River 3 nuclear unit, with a generating capacity of 860 MW, has been shut since September 1996, for an extensive upgrade.
FPC, Florida's second-biggest electric utility, is the principal subsidiary of St Petersburg-based Florida Progress Corp.
